Complex Integration Test

Given: \(a = [4]\) and \(b = [3]\)
  1. What is \(a + b\)?
  2. What is the function \(f(x) = ax + b\)?
  3. What type of function is this?

Solution

When \(a = [4]\) and \(b = [3]\):
  • Sum: \([4] + [3] = [7]\)
  • Function: \(f(x) = [4]x + [3]\)
  • Type: Linear (degree 1 polynomial)
